notes.title: Dyed In White is now available to wishlist!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021791/54ae1bd865d11d2ccae94b13e509d316dcbb12cb.png
Hello, everyone!

We’re delighted to reveal our next upcoming release Dyed In White!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3536260/Dyed_in_White/

A laid-back NTR RPG with a thrilling story and multiple endings. As Hayato, pursue becoming a Holy Knight alongside beautiful Leia. Delve into her deepest thoughts and shield her from other men. Can you protect her purity in a world full of temptation?

notes.title: Countdown to NTR is now available to purchase!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021791/5a03da4bef4982789ab94a524a5e56daf2f7e9b0.png

Hello everyone!

The race towards (stolen) love starts now: Countdown to NTR has been officially launched with a 20% off discount! Thanks so much for your support!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2919130/Countdown_to_NTR/

Five days. That’s all the time Bell has to confess his true feelings to Lumia, beautiful singer and love of his life. She left their hometown in pursuit of her dreams – can Bell become a part of her dreams, or will someone else charm Lumia's heart? Let the countdown begin!
